W.note: Single-parcel toast with a clean collapsed row, a smooth 260ms grid-rows open and a 160ms close, a five-step rail with dates and delivery window, an exception block with actions, and inert panel plus aria-expanded when closed.

X.note: The collapsed pill is the most compact of the four, but it is a multi-package list with no per-package timeline, the open and close are instant with no transition, and the chevron is a tiny glyph.

Y.note: The richest tracking content (filters, five-step timeline, events, carrier and tracking number) but the open panel is tall, the toggle has no transition, the tracking input has only a placeholder, and the whole region re-renders on each click so focus is lost and the live region re-announces everything.

Z.note: Strong single-parcel toast: a compact row that opens smoothly into a timeline with expected windows, a clear amber exception state with actions, labelled hide and notice dismiss buttons, aria-pressed on Keep open, and focus returned after re-render; the tracking number is only in the aria-label, not visible.
